text: If you see yourself as a victim, women will see you the same way. Period. Hey guys, today I want to talk about a mindset that holds back a lot of men. It's victim mentality. You know that voice inside your head that says, life is so unfair to me, my parents raised me wrong, I didn't have enough money, other kids bullied me in school, and the list goes on forever. Here is the problem. Those thoughts don't make your life easier. They actually keep you stuck. And the crazy part, some people even get addicted to them. Because replaying the same sad story gives them a weird sense of comfort. But ask yourself, is it helping you? Or is it holding you back? Look, everyone has trauma. Everyone has struggles. Nobody had a perfect life. What matters is not your past, but what you do right now. That's where your power is. And please, stop wishing you were someone else. I wish I was born richer, taller, better looking. Come on, that is not happening. And it's a waste of your energy. Instead, accept your starting point with all its positive and negative sides. Then focus on your next action. Improving your looks, building your career, developing your mindset. Because if you carry a victim mentality into dating, you'll attract women with the same negativity. Like attracts like. And trust me, you don't want that. So ditch the victim thinking. Own your past, focus on the present, and take real steps to create the future you want.
